about: The C example ANGUIRUS rebuilt in blocks and taken deeper: shield hits call him (8, then 16, then 24), a mode of his own for 90 s; four stages (charge the spikes at the shields, three rolling attacks at the Big loop, 20 s apart at most, three bites at the chasing ramp, the allies' hurry-up at the Building), his title saying what is left and his line the shot; cash the pot out at the right scoop after any stage. Destroy All Monsters (1968) and Final Wars (2004).
lost: PAD-675: he is a mode of his own, held off by the game's modes and holding them off, 90 s on his clock; the C joined the game's kaiju battles and left with them (half the pot).

The SPIKES gauge keeps its label: the C relabelled it ROLLING! while he rolls; from THE BITE on it stays full. A charged spike's shield goes dark (it no longer counts; the gauge shows the charge), where the C lit it solid.
The roll's window is 20 s, the same each time he joins (PAD-658: a window inside a stage is 20 s at least), where the C's was 6 s.
The Big loop's chase turns to a fast blink in the window's last 5 s (looked at once a second), where the C stepped its blink every tick.

On Godzilla Pro 1.16 the Maser target stands in for the center shield (a third spike to charge): the C charged with two spikes on the Pro's two shields; its lines name the Maser target there (title_alt words).
The C's total gave way at once when another of our modes asked to start; the blocks' runtime TOTAL runs its 3 s.
